consequenceSummary: Single T>G transversion 27bp upstream of APOA1 transcription start site on the negative strand disrupts core promoter architecture, causing strong cell-type-specific transcriptional dysregulation.
clinicalRelevance: APOA1 encodes the primary protein constituent of high-density lipoprotein (HDL) particles. Promoter disruption impairs hepatic synthesis, predisposing to accelerated atherosclerosis.

avi.explanation: AlphaGenome Variant Impact prioritizes variants based on predicted molecular effects. At the 99.998th percentile, this variant is in the top tier of predicted expression perturbations genome-wide.

modalities.altSignalDesc: Severe transcript attenuation with diminished coverage across exon-intron boundaries.

modalities.name: Chromatin Accessibility (DNase I / ATAC)

modalities.altSignalDesc: Collapsed chromatin accessibility envelope over the -27bp region.

modalities.name: In Silico Mutagenesis & TF Motif Disruption

modalities.altSignalDesc: Guanine substitution creates steric and electrostatic clash, aborting TF occupancy.

consequenceSummary: Abolishes the canonical 5' splice donor site (score drop > 14) and activates a cryptic splice donor exactly 60bp downstream (+14 score gain), driving a 60bp in-frame exon extension (+20 amino acids).
clinicalRelevance: In-frame insertion of 20 residues into the COL6A2 collagen chain disrupts triple-helix folding and extracellular matrix microfibril assembly, causing muscular dystrophy.

avi.explanation: AlphaGenome predicts an extreme splicing rearrangement (Quantile > 0.99999) swapping canonical donor recognition for a downstream cryptic donor.

modalities.refSignalDesc: Peak donor probability at pos 46126238; baseline noise at pos 46126298.
modalities.altSignalDesc: Complete collapse of donor signal at 46126238; emergence of sharp, dominant donor peak at 46126298.

consequenceSummary: Destroys the canonical 3' UTR polyadenylation signal hexamer (AATAAA -> AATGAA), resulting in cleavage failure, transcript read-through, and mRNA instability.
clinicalRelevance: HBA2 encodes the alpha-globin chain of adult hemoglobin (HbA). Failure of polyadenylation produces unstable elongated transcripts, causing severe microcytic hypochromic anemia.

avi.explanation: High Splice Junction score (+1.07) in a 3' UTR variant signals aberrant 3' transcript processing and failure of transcriptional termination.

modalities.name: Aberrant 3' Processing (Splice Junctions Scorer)
modalities.interpretation: High score in the splice junctions metric reflects transcript failure to terminate at the canonical cleavage site, creating aberrant chimeric read-through transcripts.
modalities.refSignalDesc: Clean termination at the polyA cleavage site (~15-30nt downstream of AATAAA).
modalities.altSignalDesc: Spillover RNA-seq read coverage past the termination boundary into downstream intergenic chromatin.

modalities.name: Polyadenylation Site Usage (PAS)
modalities.interpretation: Catastrophic loss of cleavage and polyadenylation specificity at the canonical HBA2 3' end.
modalities.refSignalDesc: Near 100% proximal PAS utilization for high-efficiency mature mRNA synthesis.
modalities.altSignalDesc: Abolition of normal cleavage; reliance on unstable downstream non-canonical signals.

category: De Novo TF Binding Site Creation
consequenceSummary: Creates a de novo consensus ETS / GABP binding motif (CCGGAA) in the TERT core promoter, driving chromatin decompaction and inappropriate telomerase reactivation in somatic tissues.
clinicalRelevance: TERT is normally repressed in mature somatic tissues. The C228T promoter mutation allows GABP transcription factor recruitment, preventing telomere shortening and conferring cellular immortality.

avi.explanation: Predicted de novo ETS transcription factor docking site accompanied by significant gain in chromatin accessibility (ATAC) and CAGE promoter initiation.

modalities.name: Transcription Factor Binding (ETS / GABP ChIP-TF)
modalities.interpretation: Creation of the CCGGAA core recognition sequence drives strong recruitment of GABPA/GABPB multimeric transcription factor complexes.
modalities.refSignalDesc: Negligible baseline ETS binding over the repressed wild-type promoter.
modalities.altSignalDesc: Sharp, intense de novo ChIP-TF peak precisely centered on the G>A substitution.

modalities.name: Chromatin Accessibility (ATAC-seq Gain)
modalities.interpretation: GABP binding promotes nucleosome displacement and chromatin decondensation across the 500bp promoter region.
modalities.refSignalDesc: Closed, heterochromatic promoter configuration with minimal transposition events.
modalities.altSignalDesc: Prominent ATAC hypersensitive peak establishing open chromatin permissive for transcription.

clinicalRelevance: In humans with homozygous deletion of SMN1, the paralog SMN2 cannot fully compensate due to this single C>T transition, precipitating progressive motor neuron degeneration in SMA.

disease: Fetal Hemoglobin (HbF) Persistence / Sickle Cell Modifier
consequenceSummary: Disrupts the consensus GATA1 binding motif in the lineage-specific +58kb erythroid enhancer of BCL11A, selectively reducing erythroid chromatin accessibility and BCL11A expression without impairing neurodevelopment.
clinicalRelevance: BCL11A is the master repressor of fetal gamma-globin. Enhancer disruption de-represses HbF, ameliorating sickle cell disease and beta-thalassemia (basis of CRISPR gene therapies like exagamglogene autotemcel).

avi.explanation: Extreme cell-type selectivity: high impact on erythroid GATA1 binding and chromatin accessibility, but completely neutral in non-erythroid tissues.

modalities.name: Transcription Factor Binding (GATA1 ChIP-seq)
modalities.interpretation: Abolition of the GATA1 core WGATAR consensus recognition sequence prevents master erythroid transcription factor binding.
modalities.refSignalDesc: Strong, focused GATA1 binding peak at +58kb locus in erythroid progenitor chromatin.
modalities.altSignalDesc: Complete ablation of GATA1 peak down to background levels.

modalities.name: Chromatin Accessibility (Erythroid ATAC-seq)
modalities.interpretation: Loss of GATA1 pioneer factor activity causes focal chromatin compaction at the +58kb enhancer loop anchor.
modalities.refSignalDesc: Open, hyper-accessible chromatin state in erythroid cells.
